slides.label: Ask Sutram
slides.title:
Five questions
for November
slides.subtitle:
What this month’s sky is asking,
and where to ask it

slides.label: Jupiter in Leo · since 31 October
slides.title:
“Which part of my life
does the teacher walk into?”
body: Jupiter is the teacher: growth, mentors, savings
Where Leo sits in your chart gets his attention

slides.label: Mercury turns forward · 13 November
slides.title:
“Should I sign now,
or after the 13th?”
body: The messenger walks backward until 13 November
Contracts, launches and big messages: check the timing
Ask for a good window in your own chart

slides.label: Venus in Virgo · 5 to 22 November
slides.title:
“What’s going on with
my love life and spending?”
body: The lover slips back into his weakest sign
Ask which house he is crossing for you

slides.label: Mars joins Jupiter and Ketu · 12 November
slides.title:
“Where should I push,
and where should I pause?”
body: The soldier walks into Leo with the teacher and the monk
13 to 16 November, all three within a degree
Ask where Leo falls in your chart

slides.label: Your own chapter
slides.title:
“Which dasha am I in,
and what is it about?”
body: Transits are the weather; your dasha is the chapter
Ask which graha runs your years, and until when

slides.title: Ask yours
slides.subtitle: Pick one question and ask it today
